Bourbon Biscuits
By: Nithya Praveen
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 1:56pm

Ingredients




1 cup All Purpose Flour / Maida
1/2 cup Sugar
1/4 cup Butter
1/4 tsp Baking Soda
1 tsp Honey (optional)
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
3 teaspoons Cocoa
2 tsps Vanilla Essence
3 tablespoons Cold milk
For Filling (Butter icing)
1/4 cup Butter
1/2 cup Icing Sugar
1 teaspoon Cocoa
1-2 tablespoon bourbon

Preparation

1 Beat the butter and sugar till light and fluffy. 2 Add essence,honey and Baking Soda and blend well. 3 Sieve the Flour with Cocoa and baking powder. 4 Mix the Flour to the creamed mixture and form a soft dough. 5 Add cold milk to this dough. 6 Roll out the prepared dough on a board(You may use a li’l flour for dusting) 7 Cut with a cookie cutter. 8 Prick on top of the cut shapes with a toothpick and sprinkle sugar. 9 Place on a greased and floured baking tray and bake at 355F for 8-10mins. 10 Cool it for 2mins before using the filling. 11 For the filling: 12 Mix all the filling ingredients to a smooth paste. 13 Sandwich the biscuits with this chocolate butter icing.

About


This is something that i have loved right from the time was a kid. My cousin passed on this recipe to me and i make this very often. This is one of the very old and popular biscuits in India. Kids completely enjoy eating this:)
